public.text: Indicative timeframes are introduced without a clear evidence basis and may create unrealistic expectations across countries with widely different scale and starting conditions.
public.suggestedRevision: Either provide the basis for the timeframes or describe them as illustrative only. Encourage countries to estimate duration from scope, readiness, procurement, data remediation, governance, and capacity.
